args.question: Please provide the cardholder's statement regarding the cancelled recurring transaction and any evidence of their cancellation request.

args.narrative: Merchant disputes Visa reason 13.2 (Cancelled Recurring Transaction). The cardholder's card was authorised (auth 418716, approved Y, $39.96) and captured (ref 395feeb80e3e, $39.96) on 2026-02-03. Merchant terms (version 2025-11) were accepted by the customer, and a confirmed cancellation was issued by email on 2026-02-20, prior to any service delivery. The issuer's statement that 'the order never arrived' is inconsistent with an approved, captured transaction and a pre-capture cancellation. We request the chargeback be reversed.

args.explanation: The issuer accepted our representment. We submitted the receipt (ref 395feeb80e3e, $39.96), the approved authorization record (auth 418716, Y), the terms acceptance (v2025-11), and the confirmed email cancellation (2026-02-20) as evidence. The cardholder's statement that 'the order never arrived' was inconsistent with an approved and captured transaction followed by a pre-capture cancellation. The issuer reversed the chargeback (issuer_accept on 2026-03-12, resolved 2026-04-01). No refund was issued by the merchant; the chargeback liability was removed.
